components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: separators are stripped, a leading '+'
            keeps the supplied country code otherwise '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped, and the result must carry 8 to 15
            digits after the '+'. For example '0412 345 678' is stored and
            returned as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-30'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

        - type: object
          properties:

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:

## What I implemented

The rule: **reject creating an owner when another owner has the same `lastName` and `address` (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) → HTTP 409, unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.**

## Changes

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `sharesHousehold` boolean (`writeOnly`) to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the POST body deserializes it. The OpenAPI generator produced `OwnerFieldsDto.getSharesHousehold()`.

2. **`service/ClinicService.java`** — Declared `existsOwnerInHousehold(String lastName, String address)`, mirroring the existing `existsOwnerWithTelephone` pattern.

3. **`service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`** — Implemented it: normalizes both `lastName` and `address` (trim → collapse whitespace runs to a single space → lower-case) and checks whether any existing owner matches on both.

4. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — After the existing telephone-conflict check, returns `409 CONFLICT` when `sharesHousehold` is not `true` and a household duplicate exists.

- `functionalityAllowsDifferentAddress` → 2xx ✓
